integrity: The included Python and C++17 verifiers exhaustively inspect all 4096 candidate subsets from distinct graph constructions and reproduce the stated minimum sizes, exact multiplicities and completion geometry.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the twelve-vertex ordinary icosahedron under radius-one closed-neighborhood identification, with adversarial deletion of selected detectors; does not extend to signal corruption or other graphs. Historical originality is best-knowledge and not independently certified.
title: An antipodal six-axis classification of erasure-robust icosahedral identifying codes
